purpose: prove the program-running metalanguage on one real bounded information-research path without importing legacy control flow

inputs.inquiry: one inquiry with acceptance and stop conditions
inputs.sources: two existing project Document rows addressed by SourceRef
inputs.document_capture: submission-time exact bytes captured to project successor_values as immutable CapturedMaterialSnapshot

runtime_shape.queue: runtime_work_items with SKIP LOCKED plus fairness and claim-time reservation

owner_rules.document_content: legacy mutable canonical source; no write authority transfer
owner_rules.delivery_receipt: project receipt store authoritative immutable record; Ledger stores delivered_as ref

acceptance: two RuntimeNodes cannot hold valid leases for one work item simultaneously
Document bytes are captured once and replayed by content digest
Research Ledger does not copy or update legacy Document content
EvidenceQualification is stored only as a relation
claim or gap keeps support contradiction uncertainty and provenance visible
artifact citation closure binds exact material and qualification refs
approval or authority epoch drift rejects a stale delivery intent
crash after artifact stage does not repeat upstream effects
crash after canonical commit before runtime event recovers by readback
crash after internal delivery before receipt event does not duplicate delivery
runtime and research projections delete and rebuild from their own authorities
a gap can materialize a named successor inquiry without mutating the running plan
